scope: Conservative continuous roll clearance bound for newly placed nut and screw.
rmax: Maximum distance to roll X axis bounded by source CAD AABB corners
stop_condition: Evaluate bound once for two parts on each foot against all recorded neutral targets
limitations: Existing servo motion-group assignment is an unqualified assembly hypothesis
Only nut and screw, not entire foot or harness
No deformation, geometry tolerance or joint backlash included beyond inherited nominal margin
